subject: shiny tags glossary: how to know which ones does what?

messages.author: 81bb5c21cf2daa4b
messages.subject: shiny tags glossary: how to know which ones does what?
parts:
Dear all,

On the RStudio website, I have found the glossary of shiny tags


http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/tag-glossary.html

The explanations on this page are limited to a few frequently occurring examples.
However, how can I know which tag does exactly what? The help page for tags() stays at a very general level, and when I try to obtain information at the level of an individual tag (e.g. 
> ?tags$input) I get the answer that there is no documentation. 

Does anyone know whether there is some more documentation or tutorials out there,

Best regards
Laurent Franckx
